top_state_drivers.section_title: Top State Drivers - Paid PMPM Change

states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $25.30 (+37.6%) over the R6 period ending April 2026. The increase was driven primarily by rising cost per admit, with ALOS expansion as the dominant sub-driver.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by Cost — Admit Impact: $4.54 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $20.76 PMPM.
Cost per Admit breakdown: ALOS Impact: $13.57 PMPM, CMI Impact: $-3.54 PMPM, CMI-adj Cost per Day Impact: $10.73 PMPM.
ALOS increased from 4.89 to 5.82 days, indicating longer inpatient stays are the primary cost pressure.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in DRG 927 (Extensive Burns with MV >96 Hours with Skin Graft) and DRG 219 (Cardiac Valve/Major Cardiothoracic Procedures with MCC), together accounting for 26.8% of the total cost change, approximately $6.86 of PMPM change. Both DRGs were absent in the prior period, reflecting new high-acuity cases.
Acute Dermatological conditions account for 39.9% of the total cost change.
HMO product accounts for 42.9% of the total cost change, with PMPM changing by $10.93.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: MaineHealth Maine Medical Center Portland: 42.4% contribution, $10.73 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+24%).
Massachusetts General Hospital: 13.8% contribution, $3.52 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+86%).

additional_signals: New member mix changed by -0.1 percentage points, from 3.4% to 3.3%.
NPAR activity is negligible in Maine with minimal out-of-network paid amounts in both periods.

states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $17.74 (+31.1%) over the R6 period ending April 2026. The increase is driven by both rising utilization and cost per admit, with an 8.7% membership decline amplifying PMPM.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is driven by Both Utilization and Cost — Admit Impact: $7.21 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $10.53 PMPM.
Admit rate increased from 14.2 to 16.0 per 1,000 members, while cost per admit rose from $48230.71 to $56147.91.
CMI-adjusted Cost per Day was the dominant Level 2 driver at $10.30 PMPM, indicating unit price increases independent of case complexity.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in DRG 003 (ECMO/Tracheostomy with MV >96 Hours) and DRG 002 (Heart Transplant/Implant of Heart Assist System), together accounting for 51.8% of the total cost change, approximately $6.41 of PMPM change. This reflects high-acuity, low-frequency cases entering the current period.
Malignant neoplasm with Surgery/Active Management accounts for 60.6% of the total cost change.
Chronic Cardiovascular accounts for 60.6% of the total cost change.
PPO/EPO product accounts for 95.4% of the total cost change, with PMPM changing by $17.14.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: UCHealth University of Colorado Hospital: 53.8% contribution, $7.38 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+61%).
Saint Joseph Hospital: 9.2% contribution, $1.16 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+80%).

additional_signals: Membership decreased by -8.7%, amplifying PMPM increase as fixed costs spread over fewer members.
New member mix changed by +0.4 percentage points, from 2.9% to 3.3%.
NPAR paid decreased by 68.4% from $1.83M to $579K. IDR cases decreased by 10, indicating reduced network pricing pressure.

states.summary: Paid PMPM increased by $21.69 (+25.2%) over the R6 period ending April 2026. The increase is primarily driven by rising cost per admit, with CMI-adjusted cost per day as the dominant sub-driver indicating unit price pressure.

drivers.title: What's Driving the Change
description: The change is primarily driven by Cost — Admit Impact: $5.77 PMPM, Cost per Admit Impact: $15.92 PMPM.
Cost per Admit breakdown: ALOS Impact: $-3.75 PMPM, CMI Impact: $2.05 PMPM, CMI-adj Cost per Day Impact: $17.61 PMPM.
ALOS decreased slightly from 5.66 to 5.43 days, but CMI-adjusted unit costs rose significantly, pointing to pure price/reimbursement increases.

drivers.title: What Services are Driving It
description: The change is concentrated in DRG 007 (Lung Transplant) and DRG 219 (Cardiac Valve/Major Cardiothoracic Procedures with MCC), together accounting for 27.5% of the total cost change, approximately $6.54 of PMPM change. DRG 007 is a new high-cost case absent in the prior period.
Chronic Respiratory conditions account for 38.0% of the total cost change.
PPO/EPO product accounts for 98.6% of the total cost change, with PMPM changing by $21.37.

drivers.title: Which Providers Are Driving It
description: Yale New Haven Hospital: 28.8% contribution, $6.59 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+21%).
New York-Presbyterian Weill Cornell Medical Center: 17.3% contribution, $4.18 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (new provider).
Hospital of Central Connecticut, New Britain Campus: 13.8% contribution, $3.33 PMPM impact, increasing-cost (+125%).

additional_signals: New member mix changed by -0.3 percentage points, from 3.0% to 2.6%.
NPAR activity increased by 287.2% but remains a small contributor ($87K CP vs $22K PP). IDR cases unchanged at 0.
